role: XCTest suite for the phone→Watch message contract in WatchMessageDecoding (Watch target source compiled into the app tests): field decode and absent≠zero, wrong-type/out-of-range rejection, recording transitions and Save & Done banner, request clearing, command parsing, display-only gating, Watch-side wording of band/pace/refusals, phone refusal/voice-chat replies, WatchPayloadBounds, and the phone-silence/wrist-stop session rules.
types: WatchMessageDecodingTests: class (XCTestCase) — pure decoder tests plus a few phone-side reply builders

flags.text: WatchMessageDecoding.decode's doc says any wrong-typed value is treated as absent rather than coerced; on the shipping path NSNumber bridges between Int, Double and Bool (an integer distance reads as a Double, 1 as true), which testNumbersBridgeBetweenIntAndDoubleOnTheWire pins for Int/Double. Only string-versus-number mismatches are absent.

units.does: Decodes a message with every known field and asserts each typed value (HR 142, %max 78, peak 171, elapsed 1845, distance 5012.5, pace text, α1 0.72, band 'aerobic', cadence, elevation, zone 2, units, displayOnly, paused flags, recording, voice state).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Named 'decode reads every known field' but the payload omits bandCode, alpha1Status, paceSecPerKm, ts and type, and the test never asserts sportLabel/sportRaw although it sends 'sport'; sentAt, sportRaw and isLiveSnapshot decoding are not covered by it.
